title: feat(toolbar): multi-line list and blockquote toggle

commits.message:
feat(toolbar): multi-line list and blockquote toggle

Extend toggleBlockquote, toggleOrderedList, and toggleUnorderedList
to operate on all selected lines instead of only the cursor line.

When a multi-line selection is active, the toggle:
- Removes the prefix if every non-empty line already has it
- Adds the prefix otherwise (with sequential numbering for ordered lists)
- Skips empty lines and preserves indentation
- Handles task lists, mixed marker types, and ordered/unordered conversion

Roadmap: #1 (P1)
